name: Ken Lederman
tagline: Top rated Environmental attorney in Seattle, Washington
about: Ken Lederman is an attorney providing legal services covering Environmental, Environmental Litigation and Real Estate: Business.

Ken Lederman, who practices law in Seattle, Washington, was selected to Super Lawyers for 2012 - 2026. This peer designation is awarded only to a select number of accomplished attorneys in each state. The Super Lawyers selection process takes into account peer recognition, professional achievement in legal practice, and other cogent factors.
Prior to becoming an attorney, he studied at Seattle University School of Law. He graduated in 1996. After passing the bar exam, he was admitted to legal practice in 1996.

The Super Lawyers patented selection process is peer influenced and research driven, selecting the top 5% of attorneys to the Super Lawyers lists each year. We know lawyers and make it easy to connect with them.
